findings.text: the follower subprocess inherits the whole ambient environment, so a session that itself runs under crew follow breaks this file's own tests: with RECKON_FOLLOWER_OWNER set, one run of the file at 988c2a46b5ec6ea5f098c14363aa91fe0a0da693 returned 2 failed / 1 passed, the same run under env -i passed, and the variable alone reproduces the failure, so a worker inside a followed session cannot reproduce this node's gate result.

the gate logs name revision f0ada2c60f317b7d790f32b0af3788b481048921, which is the revision the change is not in, while the tree under test carried the change and the change was committed two minutes later as 6f4e9d491; the same string heads all twenty n8 logs, smoke.log and n8-trial.log and the negative control, so no log ties its 3-passed result to a reviewed commit.

the manifest carries no baseline_suite/after_suite fields, so the store's read-time annotation reports added_failure_count null for this run while the run's own gate logs support a count of zero, and every reader through read_review sees the unmeasured state.
